name: @cascade/extension
description: Cascade — an Ollama-native AI coding agent for VS Code.

cascade.provider.description: Model provider. ollama/openai/nvidia/groq/openrouter/llamacpp are OpenAI-compatible; 'custom' is any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (set cascade.baseUrl); anthropic is not yet implemented.

cascade.model.description: Model id for the selected provider (for Ollama, must be installed: run `ollama list`).

cascade.baseUrl.description: Optional base URL override; REQUIRED for provider 'custom'. Leave empty to use the provider's default (Ollama → http://127.0.0.1:11434, OpenAI → https://api.openai.com, NVIDIA → https://integrate.api.nvidia.com).

cascade.apiKey.description: API key for hosted providers. Prefer leaving this EMPTY and exporting the provider's env var instead (OPENAI_API_KEY, NVIDIA_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, or CASCADE_API_KEY) — settings sync can upload this value in plain text.

cascade.permissionMode.description: How tool calls are gated. default: ask before writes. acceptEdits: auto-allow writes/edits. plan: read-only, block all writes. bypass: allow everything (no prompts).

cascade.allowTools.description: Tool names to always allow without prompting (e.g. ["Write"]).

cascade.trace.description: Write a forensic JSONL trace of each run to <workspace>/.cascade/trace-<timestamp>.jsonl (full model requests/responses, tool I/O, permission decisions, timing).

cascade.contextWindow.description: Context window in tokens for compaction sizing. 0 = auto (known-model map, else 8192). For Ollama, set this to your model's num_ctx (Ollama defaults num_ctx to ~4k regardless of the model's max).

cascade.compactRatio.description: Compact the conversation when estimated tokens reach this fraction of the context window.

cascade.keepRecentRatio.description: Fraction of the context window kept as verbatim recent messages during compaction (the rest is summarized).

cascade.compactEconomics.description: Compaction cost model (ADR-078). auto: native Ollama gets 'constrained' (compact rarely but DEEP — each full re-prefill is expensive on a KV-wall backend), hosted APIs get 'hosted' (incremental, at the auto threshold). Override only to experiment.

cascade.maxTurns.description: Max model round-trips per submit before the agent loop stops. The core default (10) suits short chat; real coding tasks need more. 0 = core default.

cascade.maxOutputTokens.description: Max tokens the model may generate per response — sizes the compaction summary reserve and is sent to the provider. 0 = AUTO: derived from the context window (window/8, at least 2048, capped by the model's published max and 16384). Set a number to pin it; raise it if long file writes get truncated.

cascade.temperature.description: Sampling temperature passed to the provider on every turn (ADR-067). -1 = backend default. For weak local models, match your Modelfile's tuned value.

cascade.utilityModel.description: Small model for SIDE-QUERIES — compaction summaries and memory curation — so they don't evict the main model's KV cache (e.g. "qwen3:4b"; pull it first). Same provider/endpoint as the main model. Empty = side-queries use the main model.

cascade.additionalDirectories.description: Extra absolute directories Cascade may read/write WITHOUT asking, in addition to the workspace. Paths outside the workspace and this list still work — they just prompt for approval each time. Other folders of a multi-root workspace are included automatically.

cascade.contextFiles.description: Workspace-relative files pinned into the system prompt and re-read FRESH each turn (ADR-056) — always present, never compacted (e.g. ["PLAN.md", "docs/CONVENTIONS.md"]). Keep them small: they cost context every turn.

cascade.checkCommand.description: The command that defines "done" for agent tasks in this workspace (e.g. `npm test`). When set, Cascade refuses premature completion until the model has run it (two reminders, then accepts). Empty = default behavior: a gentler single reminder that only fires after unverified file edits.

cascade.embedModel.description: Embedding model for archival (semantic) memory. Pull it first (e.g. `ollama pull nomic-embed-text`). If unavailable, archival memory falls back to keyword search.

cascade.autoMemory.description: Experimental self-curation: after each turn, extract durable facts to archival memory automatically. OFF by default — per-turn extraction is naive (duplicates, transient facts, poisoning/drift). Phase 11 replaces it with event-driven (compaction + session-end) consolidation.

cascade.mcpServers.description: MCP servers to register, keyed by name. Each value: { command, args?, env?, disabled? }. Connected in the background at startup; tools appear as mcp__<server>__<tool>. Example: { "filesystem": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "${workspaceFolder}"] } }
